nvitk.gui.tools.registry
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.tools.registry

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   GUI tool catalog: categories, operations, and parameter schemas.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: ParamKind

.. py:class:: ParamSpec

   One tool parameter's GUI widget spec: name, label, kind, default, and (for numeric/choice
   kinds) bounds or allowed values.


   .. py:attribute:: name
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: kind
      :type:  ParamKind
      :value: 'float'



   .. py:attribute:: default
      :type:  Any
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: min
      :type:  float | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: max
      :type:  float | None
      :value: None



   .. py:attribute:: choices
      :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
      :value: ()



.. py:data:: RunMode

.. py:class:: GuiToolSpec

   Registry entry for one GUI tool: id, category, label, its parameters, layer/3D requirements,
   and how running it should behave (``run_mode``).


   .. py:attribute:: id
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: category
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: params
      :type:  tuple[ParamSpec, Ellipsis]
      :value: ()



   .. py:attribute:: needs_reference_layer
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: needs_3d
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: run_mode
      :type:  RunMode
      :value: 'layer'



   .. py:attribute:: cli_command
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



   .. py:attribute:: description
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



   .. py:attribute:: multilabel
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



.. py:data:: TOOL_IDS_USING_LABEL_PICKER
   :type:  frozenset[str]

.. py:data:: _CATEGORY_ORDER
   :value: ('Restoration', 'Filters', 'Morphology', 'Centerline', 'Segmentation', 'Registration',...


.. py:data:: _LABEL_ID

.. py:data:: _LABEL_IDS

.. py:data:: _NEW_ID

.. py:data:: _OUTPUT_DIR

.. py:data:: _WORKING_DIR

.. py:function:: _totalseg_task_choices() -> tuple[str, Ellipsis]

   Available TotalSegmentator task names, falling back to a small hardcoded set if the class-map
   registry can't be imported.


.. py:data:: _TASK

.. py:data:: _CORRECTION_IDS

.. py:data:: _MORPH_PARAMS

.. py:data:: _TOOLS
   :type:  tuple[GuiToolSpec, Ellipsis]

.. py:data:: _PIPELINE_GUI
   :type:  tuple[GuiToolSpec, Ellipsis]

.. py:data:: _TOOLS

.. py:function:: categories() -> list[str]

   Display order of tool categories.


.. py:function:: tools_for_category(category: str) -> list[GuiToolSpec]

   All registered tool specs belonging to *category*.


.. py:function:: tool_by_id(tool_id: str) -> GuiToolSpec | None

   Look up a registered :class:`GuiToolSpec` by its id, or ``None`` if unregistered.


.. py:function:: operations_for_category(category: str) -> list[str]

   Display labels of every tool in *category*, for populating the operation dropdown.


.. py:function:: tool_id_from_label(category: str, label: str) -> str | None

   Resolve a category/label combination back to its tool id, or ``None`` if unmatched.


.. py:function:: default_category() -> str

   The category selected by default when the Tools panel first loads.


.. py:function:: default_operation(category: str) -> str

   The operation label selected by default for *category* (its first tool, or ``""`` if empty).


.. py:function:: params_for_tool(tool_id: str) -> tuple[ParamSpec, Ellipsis]

   Parameter specs registered for *tool_id*, empty if the tool is unknown or has none.


.. py:function:: operation_help_text(tool_id: str | None) -> str

   Brief description for the selected tool (Tools panel).


.. py:data:: SGE_BLOCKLIST
   :type:  frozenset[str]

.. py:data:: SGE_BLOCKLIST_PREFIXES
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('qvtpy_stage',)


.. py:function:: is_sge_capable(tool_id: str | None) -> bool

   Return True when *tool_id* can run through :func:`run_gui_tool_headless`.


.. py:function:: sge_block_reason(tool_id: str | None) -> str

   Human-readable reason *tool_id* can't run via remote SGE, or ``""`` if it can.
